name: Mesha Gate-Scribe
loreTies: Mesha records Gate behavior from within a bronze observatory built around an inactive solar pylon. She never enters strike force play; her purpose is to preserve canon, interpret ancient signs, and warn the Creator when sacred order is about to fail.
Sacred order channels solar power into civilization.
shortBackstory: Mesha Gate-Scribe is the Aten Ra witness whose choices explain how The First Reopening changes more than the battlefield.

chapters.title: Before the Gate Spoke
chapters.text: Mesha Gate-Scribe was important before battle records named them. As lore witness and codex keeper, Mesha Gate-Scribe learned the hidden machinery beneath The Golden Dominion of Aten: who records law, who witnesses oath, who warns the living world, and who profits when warnings are ignored.

chapters.title: Faction Duty
chapters.text: Mesha Gate-Scribe's loyalty is tied to Aten Ra culture rather than battlefield glory. Their doctrine is simple and dangerous: Sacred order channels solar power into civilization. The story needs them because Titans can win fights and still misunderstand what victory costs.

chapters.title: Story Arc Tie
chapters.text: During The First Reopening, Mesha Gate-Scribe becomes a readable witness to campaign consequence. Their first appearance, Campaign 01: The First Reopening, places them where player decisions need interpretation, warning, and memory instead of another controllable unit.

chapters.title: Conflict Wound
chapters.text: The Gate pressures Mesha Gate-Scribe through knowledge. It offers signs that are useful but incomplete, trying to turn witness into accomplice. Their recurring conflict is whether to reveal truth early and risk panic, or wait for proof and risk lives.

chapters.title: Dashboard Role
chapters.text: As a non-playable character, Mesha Gate-Scribe belongs under Characters and Character Backstories. Their profile should be read beside campaign dialogue, codex unlocks, and faction pages so every briefing feels like canon consequence, not tutorial flavor.

developmentStatus: Readable NPC profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
